steps.en: Install a pinned binary and provide Gemini API credentials
steps.zh: 安装固定版本程序，提供 Gemini API 凭据

steps.en: Request a mascot image in the project assets directory
steps.zh: 请求把吉祥物图片放到项目素材目录
steps.code: gemini-api image "A friendly robot mascot for a developer tool" --out ./assets/

steps.en: Send the image request to the hosted Gemini Interactions API
steps.zh: 把图片请求发给云端 Gemini Interactions API

steps.en: Decode supported inline media, write a file and return its path
steps.zh: 解码受支持的内联媒体，写文件并返回路径

value.en: The existing assistant gets an image file without writing its own API and media-decoding glue
value.zh: 现有助手拿到图片文件，不必另写 API 接线和媒体解码代码
